principle: A Creative Family constrains decision logic and composition grammar; it does not prescribe one section topology or visual layout.

family_pairs.material_difference: THREE can braid ritual/product/multi-sense narratives with scientific support; BAUM can use a slower tree/material/environment narrative with sustainability proof. Hero, density and proof handoff need not match.

Regina can foreground counseling/risk/price/flow boundaries; Takami can organize around condition diagnosis, treatment combinations and continuity. Same reassurance family, different information topology.

family_pairs.shared_logic: aspirational authority must survive into rational commitment
family_pairs.material_difference: kakimoto arms can build authority through specialist portfolio/editorial craft; pilates K can build it through transformation imagery, program states and contemporary studio energy. One fixed premium layout would be wrong.

SHIRO can sequence producer/material/factory provenance; uka can sequence consultation, hands-on technique and accumulated salon method. Product provenance and practitioner provenance require different scene grammar.
APEX can emphasize analysis-to-personalized formulation routing; FANCL can offer lighter measurement/counseling/AI routes. Guided Choice can be a diagnostic journey, not a repeated card grid.

BODY ARCHI can use measurement/device/before-after causal sequences; zen place can use research/explanation/practice evidence. Proof authority can be quantitative or explanatory without sharing a layout.

family_pairs.shared_logic: ongoing local human relationship reduces distance
family_pairs.material_difference: Lino can foreground multi-generational local-life participation; Barbaro can foreground long tenure, face-visible neighborhood continuity and community activity. Local proof must follow actual relationship form.

Rintosull can teach machine Pilates mechanics and beginner class experience; LAVA can teach hot-yoga effects, trial flow and program breadth. Both educate, but the conceptual obstacle and next-event sequence differ.

result_summary: 8 / 8 family pairs demonstrate materially different composition possibilities
